code='''from collections import deque

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    seen = set()
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if grid[r][c] == 0 or (r,c) in seen:
                continue
            q=deque([(r,c)]); seen.add((r,c)); cells=[]
            while q:
                y,x=q.popleft(); cells.append((y,x))
                for yy,xx in ((y-1,x),(y+1,x),(y,x-1),(y,x+1)):
                    if 0<=yy<h and 0<=xx<w and grid[yy][xx]!=0 and (yy,xx) not in seen:
                        seen.add((yy,xx)); q.append((yy,xx))
            r0=min(y for y,x in cells); r1=max(y for y,x in cells)
            c0=min(x for y,x in cells); c1=max(x for y,x in cells)
            layers={}
            for y,x in cells:
                d=min(y-r0,r1-y,x-c0,c1-x)
                layers.setdefault(d,set()).add(grid[y][x])
            depths=sorted(layers)
            colors=[next(iter(layers[d])) for d in depths]
            # Each concentric rectangular band has one color; reverse the bands.
            for y,x in cells:
                d=min(y-r0,r1-y,x-c0,c1-x)
                i=depths.index(d)
                out[y][x]=colors[len(colors)-1-i]
    return out
'''
